question:

(CPO 2021 Pre)

question:
If \({3^{a+3} × 4^{a+6} × 25^{a+1}} \over{27^{a-1} × 8^{a-2} ×125^{a+4}}\)= \(4\over15^{26}\), the value of \(\sqrt{a+9}\) is: 

(CHSL 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 5.

This question is solved by equating L.H.S. to R.H.S.
So, \(2^{2a+12}\over2^{3a–6}\) = \(2^2\)
2a + 12 – 3a + 6 = 2
–a = –16 ⇒ a = 16
\(\sqrt{a+9}\) = \(\sqrt{16+9}\) = 5 
Alternatively:-
\({3^{a+3} × 2^{2a+12} × 5^{2a+2}} \over{3^{3a-3} × 2^{3a-6} ×5^{3a+12}}\) = \(4\over15^{26}\)
\(3^{–2a+6} × 2^{–a+18} × 5^{–a+10}\) = \(2^2\over15^{26}\)
Compare the power of 2 
–a + 18 = 2 ⇒ a = 16
∴ \(\sqrt{16+9}\) = \(\sqrt25\) = 5

= 54 + 4 × 54 + 4 × 55

= 54 (1 + 4) + 4 × 55

= 55 + 4 × 55

= 55 (1 + 4)

= 56
